stem.text: Astatine, $\text{At}$, is below iodine in Group 17 of the Periodic Table.
Which statement is most likely to be correct?

A.text: $\text{AgAt(s)}$ reacts with an excess of dilute aqueous ammonia to form a solution of a soluble complex.

B.text: Astatine and $\text{KCl(aq)}$ react to form $\text{KAt(aq)}$ and chlorine.

C.text: $\text{KAt(aq)}$ and dilute sulfuric acid react to form $\text{HAt(g)}$.

D.text: $\text{NaAt(s)}$ and concentrated sulfuric acid react to form astatine.
